[08_after_you_submit#1]
What happens after you submit a claim. 1. Checks. We confirm your policy was active on the treatment date and that the person treated is covered. 2. Automated triage. An automated system reads the claim and recommends whether it can be paid straight away, needs review by a claims assessor, or is likely to be declined. The system only makes a recommendation. 3. Assessor review. A claims assessor reviews every claim that is not straightforward, including claims above a limit, claims for more than 1,000, inpatient claims, claims with missing documents and claims recommended for decline. The assessor makes the decision and may approve part of a claim. 4. Payment and notification. We tell you the outcome and pay any approved amount.

[04_waiting_periods#6]
Waiting periods. Your own description is not enough. If only your own note on the claim says the treatment followed an accident, and the provider's description does not show it, a claims assessor will review the claim. Ask your provider to describe the cause of the injury on the receipt.

[10_contact_and_privacy#2]
Contact us and your data. Use the member portal to submit claims, upload receipts and referrals, track a claim, appeal a decision or make a complaint.
